marks.gloss_en: Rav Pappa: and they called him 'the slave sold for loaves'
'and all this is worth nothing to me' teaches that all that wicked one's treasures were engraved on his heart
the Holy One will in the future be a crown on the head of every righteous man, as said 'on that day the Lord of hosts will be a crown of glory' (Isa 28:5)

'and for a spirit of judgment' -- one who judges his inclination; 'who sits in judgment' -- who judges truly; 'and for strength' -- who overcomes his inclination; 'who turn back the battle' -- who give and take in Torah's battle; 'at the gate' -- scholars early and late in synagogues and study halls
the Attribute of Justice said before the Holy One: Master of the world, how are these different from those?
it [the Attribute of Justice] said: 'these too erred through wine... they stumbled (paku) in judgment (peliliya)' (Isa 28:7) -- paku is Gehinnom (1 Sam 25:31), peliliya is judges (Ex 21:22)
'and she stood in the inner court of the king's house' (Esth 5:1): R' Levi -- when she reached the chamber of idols the Divine Presence left her
'when the king saw Queen Esther' (Esth 5:2): R' Yochanan -- three ministering angels met her then: one raised her neck, one drew a thread of grace over her, one stretched the sceptre
and how much [was it stretched]? R' Yirmeya: it was two cubits and he made it twelve
'up to half the kingdom' (Esth 5:3) -- half, not all of it, and not a thing that divides the kingdom: the building of the Temple
דתניא, רבי אליעזר המודעי אומר: קנאתו במלך קנאתו בשרים
R' Yehoshua ben Korcha: [she thought] I will show him a friendly face so that he and I will both be killed
ורוב בגימטריא מאתן וארביסר הוו! -- 'verov' has the numerical value 214, not 208
ורב כתיב -- written without the vav (= p_verov_ktiv)
Ramei bar Abba: they were two hundred and eight in all, as said 'and the multitude (verov) of his sons'
כתב מבעי ליה? -- 'a writing' would be expected, not 'written'
'and they were being read' (Esth 6:1) teaches that they were read of themselves
R' Elazar: she laid traps for him, as said 'let their table become a trap before them' (Ps 69:23)
R' Yehoshua: she learned from her father's house, as said 'if your enemy is hungry, give him bread' (Prov 25:21)
R' Yehuda: so that they would not recognise that she was Jewish
Rabba: 'pride comes before a fall' (Prov 16:18)
and how many were 'the multitude of his sons' (Esth 5:11)? Rav: thirty -- ten died, ten were hanged, ten went begging at doors
the Rabbis: those who went begging were seventy, as written 'the sated (seve'im) hired themselves for bread' (1 Sam 2:5) -- read 'seventy' (shiv'im)
'on that night the king's sleep was disturbed' (Esth 6:1): R' Tanchum -- the sleep of the King of the world
Ahasuerus: what is it that Esther invited Haman? perhaps they are plotting to kill me... is there no friend who would tell me? perhaps someone did me a favour and I did not repay him
